<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 178.087 Da. The formula that best matches this mass with the allowed elements (C, H, O) is C₁₁H₁₄O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2</final_answer>
